query: According to Indian statutes, at what chronological juncture does one become accountable for criminal actions?
reference_answer:
Age of Criminal Responsibility:
In India, the age of criminal responsibility is 18 years for adults and 16-18 years for heinous crimes under the Juvenile Justice Act. Children below 7 years are not considered criminally liable.
answer: In India, one becomes criminally accountable starting from the age of 18 under the Indian Penal Code. [Document N] (if available)
